# Who Will Bring a Feather for My Headband?  

Bring me a feather from the fish eagle,  
a speck against the blue, calling God's blessing over Africa.  
Bring me a feather from the owl of the woods,  
which in the evening wraps me softly, "Hoo, hoo, hoo, hoot."  

And if we happen to meet somewhere along the way,  
I'll lift my hat politely to greet you,  
then we are part of the here and now, in this moment,  
knowing God has a plan.  
And one breath we share, freely,  
Om - Shanti - Shanti - Shanti.
